project.purpose: Compose read-only/non-live market evidence, research, portfolio decision, execution-intent, authority, reconciliation, and mature financial mechanics while keeping production financial writes explicitly unadmitted.

nodes.label: EvidencePlane
nodes.responsibility: Bind authoritative/public/private read evidence to exact provider/network/source context.
acceptance: Evidence retains provider/source identity and limits causal claims.

nodes.label: DecisionPlane
nodes.responsibility: Transform mandate/research evidence into bounded portfolio/decision artifacts without creating write authority.
acceptance: Decision artifacts remain separate from execution permission.

nodes.label: ExecutionIntent
nodes.responsibility: Project decisions into FIX/engine-compatible execution intent while keeping non-live authority explicit.
acceptance: Intent can be inspected/reconciled without submitting external orders.

nodes.label: MechanicsProviders
nodes.responsibility: Use LEAN/Nautilus/FIX/TigerBeetle/venue APIs for their mechanical domains behind thin bindings.
acceptance: Provider can be substituted only after behavior/authority equivalence is proven.

nodes.label: RealityReconciliation
nodes.responsibility: Map authoritative venue reality back to execution lifecycle/effect standing without interpreting broad absence as no-effect.
acceptance: Ambiguity retains/reconciles rather than releasing authority.

nodes.label: WriteAuthority
nodes.responsibility: Admit any future demo/live external write only after explicit separately verified execution authority.
acceptance: No external financial write occurs while NON_LIVE authority remains.
nodes.nextAction: Remain deferred until the user explicitly changes the non-live boundary and fresh provider/account evidence passes.

slices.objective: Continue read-only/private-reality and reconciliation qualification without widening NON_LIVE write authority.
acceptance: Fresh evidence improves observation/reconciliation coverage while external write authority remains false.
blockers: Private/demo/live write is explicitly not admitted.
slices.nextAction: Prefer provider-native read evidence and keep credentials outside model/planning context.

gaps: Current planning intentionally contains no live-write slice.

review.notes: Initial project-native LEGO planning projection. It does not replace owner-native architecture or evidence.
